The term "black box" on an airplane actually refers to two critical flight recorders: the flight data recorder (FDR) and the cockpit voice recorder (CVR). Despite the name, these devices are not black in color. Instead, they are painted bright orange. This is done intentionally to make them highly visible and easier to locate in the event of an accident. The bright orange color helps search and rescue teams find the recorders among debris.
